de: American Civil War: First Battle of Bull Run: At Manassas Junction, Virginia, the first major battle of the war begins and ends in a victory for the Confederate army.

de: Signing of the treaty of Constantinople between Britain, France, Russia and the Ottoman Empire, which outlines the borders of the new kingdom of Greece.

de: French campaign in Egypt and Syria: Napoleon's forces defeat an Ottoman-Mamluk army near Cairo in the Battle of the Pyramids.

t: 俄土战争（1768–74）：俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国签订《库楚克开纳吉条约》，结束战争。这是奥斯曼统…
te: Russo-Turkish War (1768–74): Russia and the Ottoman Empire sign the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca ending the war. It is the …
dz: 俄土战争（1768–74）：俄罗斯与奥斯曼帝国签订《库楚克开纳吉条约》，结束战争。这是奥斯曼统治者首次割让主要居民为穆斯林的领土，也是该帝国首次确立世俗权力与宗教权威的分离。
de: Russo-Turkish War (1768–74): Russia and the Ottoman Empire sign the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca ending the war. It is the first time that an Ottoman ruler surrendered territory largely populated by Muslims and the first time that a separation of secular and spiritual authority in the Ottoman Empire was established.

de: Qing dynasty regent Dorgon issues an edict ordering all Han Chinese men to shave their forehead and braid the rest of their hair into a queue identical to those of the Manchus.

de: Battle of Shrewsbury: King Henry IV of England defeats rebels to the north of the county town of Shropshire, England.

de: Battle of Taillebourg: Louis IX of France puts an end to the revolt of his vassals Henry III of England and Hugh X of Lusignan.

te: King Berengar I of Italy and a hired Hungarian army defeat the Frankish forces at Verona. King Louis III is captured an…
dz: 意大利国王贝伦加尔一世和雇佣的匈牙利军队在维罗纳击败了法兰克人势力. 国王路易三世被俘并被蒙上眼睛,因为他在902年违背了他做出的不回意大利的誓言.
de: King Berengar I of Italy and a hired Hungarian army defeat the Frankish forces at Verona. King Louis III is captured and blinded for breaking the oath he gave in 902 to not return to Italy.

de: The Crete earthquake occurs with a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme), causing a destructive tsunami that affects the coasts of Libya and Egypt, especially Alexandria. Many thousands are killed.
